about: The collecta of the formulary “Third Sunday after Easter” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Who showest to them that err the light of Thy truth, that they may return to the way of justice, grant to all who are numbered in the Christian profession both to reject what is hostile to that name and to pursue what befitteth it. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
